summary: Campaigns App browser setup must enter through dashboard shell clicks, not direct app URLs
details: Direct campaigns.apps.29next.com URLs do not carry the dashboard shell/framed auth context. Browser-agent workflows for Campaigns App setup should start from https://keer.29next.store/dashboard/apps/campaigns/s/ and navigate via dashboard-level clicks before editing campaign maps, packages, offers, or settings.

summary: Doctor payment-method warning can remain after rendered checkout removes unsupported methods
details: Recovery checkout renders bankcard plus Apple Pay and Google Pay only, and a rendered scan found no PayPal or Klarna. Doctor still warns from starter-template defaults/CampaignSpec shape, so the rule should distinguish source-template defaults from built rendered output or downgrade once built-output verification passes.

summary: Template clone copies inactive demo route pages unless assembly strips them
details: The Demeter slice initially brought upsell-bundle-stepper, upsell-bundle-tier-cards, and upsell-bundle-tier-pills public pages into the campaign. The active Recovery map only needs checkout, two OTO upsells, receipt, presell, and landing. Setup/build should either clone an active-route slice or explicitly remove inactive template demo pages before build.

summary: Liquid boolean-like include parameters need deterministic template guidance
details: Setting include_shipping=false in the checkout call still rendered data-next-include-shipping because Liquid treated the passed value as truthy in the include. The Demeter include needed an explicit string guard. Template contracts should document or normalize false-like include params so agents do not rediscover this behavior per run.

summary: Rendered SDK lint can be confused by SDK attributes in HTML comments
details: The rendered SDK linter initially saw data-next-upsell text inside an HTML comment in an include, even though the runtime surface was valid. Converting the comment to a Liquid comment fixed the scan. Linter guidance or the template stock should avoid rendered comments containing SDK attribute names.

summary: [campaign.allowed_domains_confirmed] Non-localhost preview/production origins are not confirmed in the Campaigns App SDK origin allowlist. SDK runtime checks may be blocked after deploy.
details: Proposed by campaigns-os findings harvest from doctor warnings.

summary: [deploy.preview_url] No preview or production URL yet. QA remains blocked after build/polish.

summary: [source_html.commerce_shell_required] Source page "template-stock/demeter/_includes/editorial-tier-selector.html" declares SDK-owned commerce zone(s): checkout, sdk_attributes. During build, adopt the selected starter-template family shell for these zones; do not wrap borrowed partials in a custom checkout/upsell structure. Browser QA will verify rendered commerce structure when the family contract declares it.
details: Proposed by campaigns-os findings harvest from doctor warnings.

summary: Demeter checkout wrappers can be runtime-hidden even when SDK hydration succeeds
details: On Recovery checkout, SDK/API calls succeeded and built HTML contained the full checkout, but .checkout-layout__content-inner and .checkout-right__content received inline display:none, collapsing the form and side summary until campaign CSS forced them visible. Template contracts/polish checks should catch zero-height commerce wrappers after hydration.

summary: Page Kit dev server needs non-interactive campaign selection for agent runs
details: npm run dev / campaign-dev opened an interactive campaign picker and did not expose a campaign slug flag, so the agent served _site directly for local polish. This works for static inspection but loses the normal Page Kit dev server path; add a --campaign or env-driven selection to keep agent runs first-time deterministic.

summary: Template chrome can imply unsupported payment methods outside SDK payment-method include
details: Recovery checkout correctly rendered only credit card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay payment methods, but Demeter trust/payment strip assets still showed a PayPal logo until hidden in campaign CSS. Payment-method gating should cover surrounding trust chrome or provide no-PayPal asset variants.
